card.text: Explore Ceres in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect the largest body in the asteroid belt, its cratered surface and the bright salt deposits Dawn mapped.

introduction.text: Ceres is the largest body in the asteroid belt. NASA's Dawn spacecraft mapped its cratered surface and bright salt deposits.

normal.title: FC visible-light mosaic
normal.summary: Photographed shadows remain in the visible-light images. The gray grid marks known gaps; some dark edges remain uncertain.

enhanced.title: False-color mosaic PIA19977
enhanced.summary: The 920, 750 and 440 nm bands are assigned false colors. Photographed shadows remain and the gray grid marks known gaps.

elevation.title: HAMO digital terrain model
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 470 km sphere. Interpolated polar terrain beyond 60° is withheld from this view.
